item.title: WWE surpasses UFC in revenue for 2025 with $1.709 billion
item.description: For the first time, WWE has surpassed the UFC in terms of revenue, with WWE pulling in a whopping $1.709 billion for 2025, up from $1.398 billion in the prior year.
